dek: A company that borrowed $250 million from Carlos Slim at 14 percent in January 2009, sold its building, dumped About.com and the Boston Globe, and watched its stock trade below $5 — has become a roughly $12 billion subscription business with 12.5 million digital subscribers, zero debt, and a stock that has compounded about 18 percent a year for 15 years. 9 chapters on how.
